changelog:
Initial release of trade-tracker: comprehensive trade tracking and attribution analysis

- Track profits & losses by transaction, stock, time period (month/quarter/year)
- Analyze trading costs (commission, estimated slippage)
- Assess holding duration per trade and group by time intervals
- Categorize and compare by trading strategy labels
- Visualize profit distribution with ASCII charts
- Support multi-strategy and multi-period comparison
- Auto-recognize common CSV field names and multiple date formats
- Local run only; no network required

按股票/月度/季度/年度归因、交易成本分析(佣金+滑点)、
持仓时间分析、策略标签归类、多策略对比、ASCII盈亏分布图。

Use when: 需要复盘交易记录、归因分析、
查看按股票/时间段的盈亏分布、成本分析、持仓结构。
